parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters, a client-generated UUID per logical submit (a retry reuses it). A repeated key with the same method, path and body returns the stored response (a 2xx, kept 24 hours; of the refusals, the final ones: malformed-request, non-increasing-version, incomplete-charge-schedule, overlapping-tax-band, rate-out-of-range, empty-quote, negative-amount, currency-mismatch) with Idempotency-Replayed: true; a retryable refusal (concurrent-update, not-found, illegal-transition, overlapping-sale-window, unknown-catalog-item, sale-not-below-list, item-not-priced, no-charge-schedule, no-tax-table, validation-failed) is not stored and its key is released, so the retry executes again; with a different method, path or body under a stored answer it is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A 5xx is never stored, so the key can retry. Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required; malformed is 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
